# U23: See the year in quarters: where we are, each quarter met or missed, and the year’s history

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `YEAR`
- **Budget:** 6 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `errors`, `logged`, `budget` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U23

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- _Note:_ A phone's Goals page has no title (goals spec, 2.4): its top bar says the week.
- If on a phone:
  - **Check:** (`entry`) it fails if the top bar does not say the week.
- Otherwise:
  - **Check:** “Week 45 of 53 · Q4 (Oct–Dec)” is shown (else: the Goals page says the week, the quarter and the year).
  - **Check:** (`entry`) the words “Week 45 of 53 · Q4 (Oct–Dec)” is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- Go to `/goals/cost-rightsize` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “This year by quarter” section shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the quarters read: {cells.join(' | ')}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “quarters”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The weekly history grid shows this quarter by default, or the whole year.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&view=history&hist=weekly` in the demo.
- **Check:** The History grid shows.
- **Step.** Press the “Whole year” button in the “Weeks shown” group.
- _Note:_ The range is in the link now, so the grid redraws from it.
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if expected {WEEKS - 39} then 53 week columns, saw {quarterCols - 1} then {yearCols - 1} (Whole year pressed: {pressed}; link {new URL(p.url()).search}).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “year grid”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
